title: Prosecutors Wanted 15 Years. Here's What Elizabeth Holmes Got

lines.say: November eighteenth, two thousand twenty-two. Elizabeth Holmes is sentenced for defrauding Theranos investors.
lines.show: November 18, 2022. Elizabeth Holmes is sentenced for defrauding Theranos investors.

lines.say: Prosecutors asked for fifteen years. Probation suggested nine. Her lawyers argued for eighteen months or less.
lines.show: Prosecutors asked for 15 years. Probation suggested nine. Her lawyers argued for 18 months or less.

lines.say: The judge put the loss at one hundred twenty million dollars, for a guidelines range of one hundred thirty-five to one hundred sixty-eight months.
lines.show: The judge put the loss at $120 million, for a guidelines range of 135 to 168 months.

lines.say: He chose the bottom. One hundred thirty-five months.
In March two thousand twenty-six, a guidelines change for first-time offenders let him cut it to one hundred twenty-three months.
lines.show: In March 2026, a guidelines change for first-time offenders let him cut it to 123 months.
